settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 7 days of delivery if the item is unused, unwashed, and in its original packaging with tags intact.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We ship within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placing them. Please contact our support team immediately if you need changes.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: Simply browse our collection, select your preferred size and color, and click Add to Cart. When you’re ready, proceed to Checkout and complete the payment securely.
